77445.subject: Commerce
77445.explanation:
Commerce started as a result of specialization. Specialization refers to the concept where individuals, businesses, or
countries focus on producing a limited scope of products or services to gain efficiencies. This leads to the need for trade
or commerce, as no one individual or region can produce everything they need.

77447.subject: Commerce
77447.question_text: The process of changing raw materials into finished goods is
77447.explanation:
The process of changing raw materials into finished goods is manufacturing. Manufacturing involves the conversion of
raw materials into finished goods using tools, human labor, and chemical or biological processing or formulation.

77452.subject: Commerce
77452.question_text: An example of a primary product is
77452.explanation:
An example of a primary product is palm oil. Primary products are goods that are available from cultivating raw
materials without a manufacturing process. Palm oil is a primary product because it is obtained directly from the palm
fruit.

77456.subject: Commerce
77456.question_text: All activities geared towards the distribution and exchange of goods and services is
77456.explanation:
Commerce involves all activities geared towards the distribution and exchange of goods and services. It includes trade
and aids to trade. Trade involves buying and selling of goods and services while aids to trade include banking, insurance,
transportation, warehousing, and advertising.

77460.subject: Commerce
77460.question_text: The word "limited" written after the name of a company means that
77460.explanation:
The word 'limited' written after the name of a company means that the liability of the shareholders of the company is
limited to the extent of the face value of shares held by them. This means that if the company goes into liquidation, the
maximum amount that they will be required to contribute will be the unpaid amount on their shares.

options.text: members are liable to the extent of their shareholdings only
the company is a going concern
it has a democratic system of management

77476.subject: Commerce
77476.question_text: Which type of occupation is a carpenter engaged in?
77476.explanation:
A carpenter is primarily involved in the construction industry. Carpenters work on building and assembling structures
made of wood, such as frames, cabinets, and furniture, as well as repairing and installing wooden components in
buildings. Their work is crucial in the construction and renovation of buildings and other structures.

77478.subject: Commerce
77478.question_text: The reward for land as a factor of production is
77478.explanation:
In economics, the four factors of production are land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship. Each factor is rewarded for its
contribution to the production process: land is rewarded with rent, labor with wages, capital with interest, and
entrepreneurship with profit. Therefore, the reward for land as a factor of production is rent.

77479.subject: Commerce
77479.question_text: Which of the following businesses can raise capital through the stock exchange?
77479.explanation:
A public company is a company that has issued securities through an initial public offering (IPO) and is traded on at least
one stock exchange or in the over the counter market. Public companies have a much larger ability to raise capital as
they can issue more shares to the public. Therefore, among the given options, only a public company can raise capital
through the stock exchange.

77480.subject: Commerce
77480.question_text: A group of people representing a cross-section of business interests in an area is
77480.explanation:
A Chamber of Commerce is a form of business network, for example, a local organization of businesses whose goal is to
further the interests of businesses. Business owners in towns and cities form these local societies to advocate on behalf
of the business community. Therefore, a group of people representing a cross-section of business interests in an area is a
chamber of commerce.

77481.subject: Commerce
77481.question_text: One of the disadvantages of selling on credit is
77481.explanation:
Selling on credit can lead to an increase in bad debts. This is because when a business sells on credit, it is essentially
lending money to its customers. If these customers fail to pay back this money, the business incurs bad debts. None of the
other options accurately represent a disadvantage of selling on credit.

77482.subject: Commerce
77482.question_text: A number of shops under one roof is a
77482.explanation:
A number of shops under one roof is a department store. A department store is a retail establishment offering a wide
variety of merchandise, organized into different departments or sections. Each department specializes in a type of
product, such as clothing, home appliances, electronics, etc. The other options do not accurately describe a number of
shops under one roof.

77483.subject: Commerce
77483.question_text: An organization of producers of similar products, which controls output with the intention to fix price is
77483.explanation:
An organization of producers of similar products, which controls output with the intention to fix price is a cartel. A
cartel is a group of independent market participants who collude with each other in order to improve their profits and
dominate the market. They do this by controlling the production and price of a product or service. The other options do
not accurately describe this type of organization.

77484.subject: Commerce
77484.question_text: One of the functions of a trade association is to
77484.explanation:
Trade associations are organizations founded and funded by businesses that operate in a specific industry. Their main
function is to promote the interests of their members. They do this by advocating for policies that will benefit the
industry, providing educational opportunities for members, and promoting the welfare of members. They do not provide
infrastructure or employment for members, nor do they pay members' salaries.

77485.subject: Commerce
77485.question_text: The practice of selling goods to a foreign country at lower prices than obtainable in the exporting country is
77485.explanation:
The practice of selling goods to a foreign country at lower prices than obtainable in the exporting country is known as
dumping. This is often done to increase market share in the foreign country or to offload excess production. It is not
speculation, skimming, or hedging. Speculation involves making high-risk investments with the hope of high returns,
skimming is a pricing strategy where a high price is set for a new product, and hedging is a risk management strategy
used in limiting or offsetting probability of loss from fluctuations in the prices of commodities,tcurrencies, or securities.

77486.subject: Commerce
77486.question_text: A foreign order which instructs an agent to buy certain goods from a particular supplier is
77486.explanation:
A closed indent is a foreign order which instructs an agent to buy certain goods from a particular supplier. It is a type of
trade document used in international commerce. An open indent, on the other hand, gives the agent discretion in the
choice of supplier. A letter of credit is a letter from a bank guaranteeing that a buyer's payment to a seller will be
received on time and for the correct amount, while a letter of enquiry is a formal method of requesting information.

77487.subject: Commerce
77487.question_text: Which of the following is not a condition for dissolution of a partnership?
77487.explanation:
Expiration of a business year is not a condition for dissolution of a partnership. A partnership can continue to operate
indefinitely as long as the partners agree to do so. The other options, such as continuous disagreement among partners,
mutual consent of the partners, and termination of the venture, can all lead to the dissolution of a partnership.

77500.subject: Commerce
77500.question_text: A country's balance of trade of-$20 million shows that its
77500.explanation:
A country's balance of trade of-$20 million shows that its import volume is greater than export. The balance of trade is
the difference between the value of a country's imports and its exports. When a country's imports exceed its exports, it
has a trade deficit, which is represented by a negative balance of trade.

options.text: import volume is greater than export
import and export volumes are equal
export volume is greater than imports

77501.subject: Commerce
77501.question_text: The collection of import duty is a function of the
77501.explanation:
The collection of import duty is a function of the customs and excise authority. Import duty is a tax collected on imports
and some exports by the customs authorities of a country. It is usually based on the value of the goods that are imported.

77503.subject: Commerce
77503.question_text: An error on an invoice may be rectified by issuing
77503.explanation: An error on an invoice can be rectified by issuing a credit note. A credit note is a document sent by a seller to its buyer, or, in other words, a vendor to the customer, notifying that a credit has been provided to their account. The reasons could be many including error on the invoice, incorrect goods sent, goods in bad condition, etc.

77505.subject: Commerce
77505.question_text:
Use the information below to answer questions below

  #
opening stock 4000
closing stock 12000
purchases 17000

What is the average stock?

77511.question_text:
Use the information below to answer questions below

closing stock 12000

17000

77517.subject: Commerce
77517.question_text: The expected response from the recipient of a quotation is to send
77517.explanation:
The expected response from the recipient of a quotation is to send an order. A quotation is a document that a seller
provides to a buyer to offer goods or services at a stated price, under specified conditions. If the buyer agrees with the
conditions and the price, they will send an order to the seller to proceed with the transaction.

77519.subject: Commerce
77519.question_text: The main function of a bureau-de-exchange is
77519.explanation:
The main function of a bureau-de-exchange is buying and selling foreign currency. A bureau de change is a business
where people can exchange one currency for another. They buy a currency from individuals or businesses at one rate (the
bid price), and sell it to others at a higher rate (the ask price). The difference between the bid price and the ask price is
how the bureau de change makes a profit.

77520.subject: Commerce
77520.question_text: The right of a seller to make correction on invoices is expressed by the term
77520.explanation:
The right of a seller to make correction on invoices is expressed by the term 'errors and omissions excepted'. This term,
often abbreviated as 'E&OE', is used in an attempt to reduce legal liability for potentially incorrect or incomplete
information supplied in a contractually related document such as a quotation or specification.

77527.subject: Commerce
77527.question_text: Speed is an important factor to be considered for choice of means of transport where goods are
77527.explanation:
Perishable goods are items that can spoil or decay quickly, such as fruits, vegetables, meat, dairy, and seafood. These
goods need to be transported quickly to prevent them from spoiling. Therefore, speed is an important factor to be
considered for the choice of means of transport where goods are perishable.

77530.subject: Commerce
77530.question_text: The practice by which insurance companies share risks with other insurance companies is
77530.explanation:
Re-insurance is a practice where insurance companies share risks with other insurance companies to reduce their
potential losses. This is done by purchasing insurance policies from other insurance companies to limit the total loss the
original insurer would experience in case of disaster. The other options do not accurately describe this practice.

77531.subject: Commerce
77531.question_text: One of the functions of the ports authority is
77531.explanation:
Ports authorities are responsible for providing various services, including warehousing services. Warehousing services
involve the storage of goods and commodities in a safe and secure environment before they are transported to their final
destination. The other options are not primary functions of the ports authority.

options.text: enforcing law and order in harbors

77536.subject: Commerce
77536.question_text: Which of the following means of payment requires acceptance by the debtor to make it valuable?
77536.explanation:
A bill of exchange requires acceptance by the debtor to make it valuable. A bill of exchange is a written order used
primarily in international trade that binds one party to pay a fixed sum of money to another party on demand or at a
predetermined date.

77537.subject: Commerce
77537.question_text: The purpose for which the Central Bank sells securities is to
77537.explanation:
The Central Bank sells securities to reduce cash in the economy. This is a monetary policy tool known as open market
operations. When the Central Bank sells securities, it is taking money out of the economy, thereby reducing the amount
of cash available in the economy.

77538.subject: Commerce
77538.question_text: The amount a current holder is allowed to withdraw in excess of the balance in his account is
77538.explanation:
The amount a current holder is allowed to withdraw in excess of the balance in his account is an overdraft. An overdraft
is a credit facility that allows an account holder to withdraw more than the current balance in their account, up to a
certain limit.

77539.subject: Commerce
77539.question_text: Which of the following business risks would an insurance firm not cover for an entrepreneur?
77539.explanation: Insurance firms cover risks that are accidental and unforeseeable. They do not cover risks that are a result of changes in market conditions or consumer behavior. A change in consumers' taste is a business risk that is influenced by market trends and consumer behavior, and therefore, it is not something an insurance firm would cover.

77540.subject: Commerce
77540.question_text: One of the qualities of tradable goods is
77540.explanation:
Divisibility is one of the qualities of tradable goods. It refers to the ability of a good to be divided into smaller units
without losing its value. For example, a bar of gold can be divided into smaller pieces and each piece will still retain its
value. This is an important quality for tradable goods as it allows for flexibility in trading.

77541.subject: Commerce
77541.question_text: Which of the following instruments of payment could be used in international trade?
77541.explanation:
A bill of exchange is a written order used primarily in international trade that binds one party to pay a fixed sum of
money to another party on demand or at a predetermined date. It is commonly used in international trade because it
provides a secure method of payment.

77542.subject: Commerce
77542.explanation:
Bonded warehouses are supervised by customs and excise authorities. A bonded warehouse is a secured area where
imported goods are stored until the import duties are paid. They are under the jurisdiction of the customs authorities,
who ensure that the duties are paid before the goods are released.

77543.subject: Commerce
77543.question_text: An advertising campaign by a chicken seller designed to sell his products at the expense of a beef seller is
77543.explanation:
An advertising campaign by a chicken seller designed to sell his products at the expense of a beef seller is competitive.
Competitive advertising is a method of attracting customers by communicating the unique attributes of a product and
how it is superior to competitor products.

77544.subject: Commerce
77544.question_text: The main idea of the marketing concepts is that all the firm's plans and operations should be
77544.explanation:
The main idea of the marketing concept is that all the firm's plans and operations should be consumer oriented. This
means that the company focuses on meeting the needs and wants of its customers in order to achieve its business goals.

77545.subject: Commerce
77545.question_text: A person who is employed for the purpose of bringing his principal into contractual relationship with the third parties is
77545.explanation: An agent is a person who is employed to bring his principal into contractual relationship with third parties. This is because an agent acts on behalf of the principal in business transactions with third parties. A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods. A consignee is a person or company to whom goods are shipped. A consignor is a person or company who ships goods to another.

77546.subject: Commerce
77546.question_text: The transfer of a government company to the public is
77546.explanation:
The transfer of a government company to the public is known as privatization. Privatization is the process of
transferring ownership of a business, enterprise, agency, public service, or public property from the public sector (a
government) to the private sector, either to a business that operates for a profit or to a nonprofit organization.
Commercialization is the process of introducing a new product or production method into commerce. Localization is
the adaptation of a product or service to meet the needs of a particular language, culture or desired population's 'look-
and-feel'. Deregulation is the reduction or elimination of government power in a particular industry asually enacted to
create more competition within the industry.

77547.subject: Commerce
77547.question_text: One of the roles performed by middle managers is
77547.explanation:
Middle managers are responsible for implementing the organizational plans and objectives that are set by top
management. They translate the strategic goals set by upper management into actionable plans for their teams.
Formulation of objectives and strategies is typically the role of top management. Review and appraisal of operational
results and review of master plans, programmes and budgets can be part of the roles of both middle and top
management, but they are not the primary role of middle managers.

options.text: review of master plans, programmes and budgets
review and appraisal of operational results
implementation of organizational plans and objectives

77548.subject: Commerce
77548.question_text: Which of the following is responsible for protecting consumers against poor quality goods?
77548.explanation:
Standard organizations are responsible for protecting consumers against poor quality goods. They set and enforce
quality standards for products and services to ensure they are safe, reliable and of good quality. They also provide
certification to products and services that meet their standards.

77549.subject: Commerce
77549.question_text: The saying that the 'consumer is always right' describes the doctrine of
77549.explanation:
The saying that the 'consumer is always right' describes the doctrine of consumer sovereignty. This doctrine suggests
that consumers dictate what goods and services are produced in the market based on their demands. Therefore,
businesses must cater to these demands to be successful.

77550.subject: Commerce
77550.explanation:
A disadvantage of privatization is that the profit motive outweighs public interest. This is because private companies are
primarily driven by profit. As a result, they may neglect the public interest in favor of actions that increase their profits.
For example, they may increase prices, reduce quality, or cut corners in ways that harm the public.

options.text: there is inefficiency in the supply of goods
the existence of monopoly is high
the profit motive outweighs public interest
there is reduction in the quality of goods

77555.subject: Commerce
77555.question_text: The act of placing goods in glass shields in front of shops to attract passers by is
77555.explanation:
Window display is a marketing strategy where goods are placed in glass shields in front of shops to attract passers-by. It
is a form of visual merchandising that aims to attract, engage, and motivate the customer towards making a purchase.

77557.subject: Commerce
77557.question_text: The practice of making a state firm more profit-oriented is
77557.explanation:
Commercialization is the process of managing or running something principally for financial gain. It is the practice of
making a state firm more profit-oriented. It involves the transformation of a public sector organization into a business
enterprise in the private sector.

77561.subject: Commerce
77561.question_text: The income generated from tourism forms part of the country's
77561.explanation:
The income generated from tourism is considered as part of the country's invisible exports. Invisible exports are services
that are sold to foreign countries, which includes tourism, banking, insurance, etc. These are called 'invisible' because
they do not result in the shipment of physical goods unlike visible exports.

77562.subject: Commerce
77562.question_text: An objective of the European Union is to
77562.explanation:
One of the main objectives of the European Union is to eliminate tariffs and quotas among member countries. This is to
promote free trade and economic integration among the member countries. Tariffs and quotas are trade barriers that
restrict the free flow of goods and services.

options.text: eliminate tariffs and quotas among member countries
eliminate drug addiction in member countries
encourage migrant workers from developing countries
fight against child abuse in developing countries

77563.subject: Commerce
77563.question_text: An inventor of a new machine for canning tomatoes can protect his product by
77563.explanation:
An inventor of a new machine for canning tomatoes can protect his product by obtaining a patent. A patent is a legal
document that gives the inventor the exclusive right to produce, sell, and use the invention for a certain period of time.
This prevents others from copying, manufacturing, selling, or importing the invention without the inventor's permission.

77565.subject: Commerce
77565.question_text: The concept of determining the objectives of a business and stating how they can be actualized is
77565.explanation:
The concept of determining the objectives of a business and stating how they can be actualized is planning. Planning
involves setting goals and determining the best way to achieve them. It involves selecting a course of action from a set of
alternatives.

77566.subject: Commerce
77566.question_text: One of the aims of ECOWAS is to
77566.explanation:
One of the aims of ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States) is to foster exchange of goods and services
among member states. This is done to promote economic integration and development in the region.

options.text: provide a market for stocks and shares
foster exchange of goods and services
